title: Current CIBA audit overlay
scope_note: Incremental re-audit of the original 159-row catalog, not a reduced replacement scope or a complete normative inventory. Other RFCs and node-specific behavior remain tracked in alignment-roadmap.md. Historical verified/excluded statuses are not automatically carried forward.

status_legend.protocol_boundary_verified: Specific gem protocol behavior has direct evidence; application/client obligations remain separate.
status_legend.partial: Evidence covers only part of the row or leaves a policy difference unresolved.
status_legend.app_contract: Application obligation documented, not proven for a deployment.
status_legend.pending: Not yet re-audited against current optional extensions.
status_legend.reference_unsupported: Conditional on a feature unsupported by both the pinned reference and gem. No implementation/conformance pass is claimed; revisit if the reference target or enabled scope changes.

reviewed_items.label: CIBA grant識別子
reviewed_items.scope: baseline discovery and opt-in CIBA client registration; optional combinations remain separately audited
reviewed_items.finding: The standard CIBA grant identifier appears in both metadata documents and drives successful authenticated token dispatch alongside the existing authorization-code flow.

reviewed_items.label: Discoveryの対応モード
reviewed_items.scope: baseline discovery and opt-in CIBA client registration; optional combinations remain separately audited
reviewed_items.finding: Default discovery advertises poll only; enabling ping advertises poll and ping. Push is not advertised. Both metadata documents agree in the custom-route test.

reviewed_items.label: Discoveryの開始URL
reviewed_items.scope: baseline discovery and opt-in CIBA client registration; optional combinations remain separately audited
reviewed_items.finding: A configured custom Backchannel route is advertised in OAuth and OIDC discovery, and an actual request to that discovered URL creates the pending record. Deployment proxy/alias rewriting is audited separately.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求の対応表明
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Configured signing algorithms appear in Discovery; disabled feature omission has baseline coverage.

reviewed_items.label: user_codeの対応表明
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: Discovery follows the feature flag; enabled metadata is asserted directly.

reviewed_items.label: Discoveryのgrant_types
reviewed_items.scope: baseline discovery and opt-in CIBA client registration; optional combinations remain separately audited
reviewed_items.finding: Both discovery documents include the CIBA grant identifier while preserving upstream grants.

reviewed_items.label: 認証方式メタデータの共有
reviewed_items.scope: Configured Basic/post, private_key_jwt/client_secret_jwt (fourteen algorithms), PKI/self-signed TLS; deployment trust and arbitrary extension combinations excluded
reviewed_items.finding: OAuth and OIDC Discovery advertise the same actual authentication-method list. The legacy assertion-type URN is removed from output only; underlying upstream dispatch and unrelated RSA clients remain unchanged. Configured Basic/post, JWT and TLS have separate direct flow evidence. Four-test three-DB regression includes shared metadata, twelve-algorithm JWT authentication and ordinary-flow coexistence; reference HTTP Discovery also excludes the URN.

reviewed_items.label: 認証署名アルゴリズムの共有
reviewed_items.scope: explicitly configured twelve RS/PS/ES/HS client assertion algorithms; other algorithm families not advertised by this fixture
reviewed_items.finding: Both discovery documents retain upstream authentication algorithms and add explicitly configured CIBA client assertion algorithms. Twelve RS/PS/ES/HS algorithms and Ed25519/EdDSA have direct endpoint verification evidence, wrong-key rejection and gem token issuance. OP ID Token signing configuration is unchanged. This covers the configured fourteen algorithms, not arbitrary backend extensions.

reviewed_items.label: 登録済み配送モード
reviewed_items.scope: baseline discovery and opt-in CIBA client registration; optional combinations remain separately audited
reviewed_items.finding: Static clients with missing, multiple or push delivery-mode values fail eligibility before persistence. DCR also rejects missing or unavailable modes without inserting a client; enabled ping has separate acceptance evidence.

reviewed_items.label: CIBA grantのクライアント登録
reviewed_items.scope: baseline discovery and opt-in CIBA client registration; optional combinations remain separately audited
reviewed_items.finding: A static client lacking the CIBA grant is rejected. Opt-in DCR with the CIBA grant creates a client that successfully starts, approves and redeems a request. This supersedes the initial audit evidence that DCR CIBA was wholly unavailable.

reviewed_items.label: 通知URL登録
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Ping client eligibility requires an HTTPS registered endpoint; changed destinations cannot receive saved credentials. Push is not implemented.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求アルゴリズム登録
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Registered algorithm gates signed input; independent client authentication remains required. DCR composition is separately covered.

reviewed_items.label: user_codeクライアント設定
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: Enabled clients accept explicit false and omitted metadata under the application policy. Disabled-feature clients declaring true are rejected, a stricter eligibility policy; this is not proof of identical handling in all deployments.

reviewed_items.label: 登録された認証方式
reviewed_items.scope: Configured Basic/post, private_key_jwt/client_secret_jwt (fourteen algorithms), PKI/self-signed TLS; deployment trust and arbitrary extension combinations excluded
reviewed_items.finding: Configured methods have direct endpoint authentication/negative evidence. Fourteen RS/PS/ES/HS/Edwards algorithms have reference HTTP and gem verification evidence; Edwards adds DCR, remote HTTP rotation/failure, installed HTTPS retrieval with untrusted-TLS rejection, replay protection and ordinary-flow coexistence. A CIBA Edwards-only configuration preserves unrelated RSA client authentication and upstream metadata. See client-auth-edwards-scope-matrix.txt and client-auth-edwards-https-installed.txt. This is bounded protocol evidence, not deployment certification.

reviewed_items.label: pairwise sector算出
reviewed_items.scope: optional pairwise poll/ping clients; no push
reviewed_items.finding: CIBA sector derives from registered remote JWKS or explicit sector URI, rather than redirect URI; nondefault port matches measured node URL.host behavior. Application owns identifier mapping.

reviewed_items.label: pairwise DCR検証
reviewed_items.scope: optional pairwise poll/ping clients; no push
reviewed_items.finding: Pairwise registration requires remote JWKS and validates explicit sector-document membership; hybrid browser clients include their redirect URIs. Verified TLS, redirect limits and rejection cases have installed-artifact evidence.

reviewed_items.label: pairwise鍵所有証明
reviewed_items.scope: optional pairwise poll/ping clients; no push
reviewed_items.finding: Configured pairwise clients require private_key_jwt or self_signed_tls_client_auth with registered remote key material. Missing keys and Basic authentication reject; a signed request alone does not waive this restriction in either gem or reference. Current private-key/pairwise and certificate-proof tests pass on three DBs, with separate installed TLS and reference HTTP/TLS evidence. This verifies the reference-supported proof methods, not push or arbitrary app identity policy.

reviewed_items.label: push pairwise sector
reviewed_items.scope: push mode, unsupported by pinned node 9.12.2 and the gem; poll/ping remain in scope
reviewed_items.finding: Conditional push behavior is not implemented or advertised. Pinned node 9.12.2 rejects push provider configuration; the gem rejects push registration and request eligibility. This records non-applicability to the shared enabled modes, not a passing push implementation.

reviewed_items.label: poll配送
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: Approved poll requests obtain a signed ID Token and access token through the token endpoint, followed by single-use rejection.

reviewed_items.label: ping配送
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Approval/denial persists before notification; authenticated retrieval remains possible despite send failure. This matches the measured reference save-before-send boundary.

reviewed_items.label: push配送
reviewed_items.scope: push mode, unsupported by pinned node 9.12.2 and the gem; poll/ping remain in scope
reviewed_items.finding: Conditional push behavior is not implemented or advertised. Pinned node 9.12.2 rejects push provider configuration; the gem rejects push registration and request eligibility. This records non-applicability to the shared enabled modes, not a passing push implementation.

reviewed_items.label: push sender-constrained token
reviewed_items.scope: push mode, unsupported by pinned node 9.12.2 and the gem; poll/ping remain in scope
reviewed_items.finding: Conditional push behavior is not implemented or advertised. Pinned node 9.12.2 rejects push provider configuration; the gem rejects push registration and request eligibility. This records non-applicability to the shared enabled modes, not a passing push implementation.

reviewed_items.label: 開始APIのTLS
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: Authenticated HTTP requests are rejected before state changes; HTTPS Rack requests are accepted. Actual TLS termination and trusted proxy configuration remain deployment responsibilities with separate TLS fixtures.

reviewed_items.label: 開始APIのPOSTとform
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: HTTPS POST form input is accepted, including non-rewindable request bodies. JSON and GET do not issue requests or tokens; malformed UTF8/form input is rejected. Backchannel GET is 404, token GET with CIBA grant is invalid_request.

reviewed_items.label: 開始APIのクライアント認証
reviewed_items.scope: Configured Basic/post, private_key_jwt/client_secret_jwt (fourteen algorithms), PKI/self-signed TLS; deployment trust and arbitrary extension combinations excluded
reviewed_items.finding: Configured methods have direct endpoint authentication/negative evidence. Fourteen RS/PS/ES/HS/Edwards algorithms have reference HTTP and gem verification evidence; Edwards adds DCR, remote HTTP rotation/failure, installed HTTPS retrieval with untrusted-TLS rejection, replay protection and ordinary-flow coexistence. A CIBA Edwards-only configuration preserves unrelated RSA client authentication and upstream metadata. See client-auth-edwards-scope-matrix.txt and client-auth-edwards-https-installed.txt. This is bounded protocol evidence, not deployment certification.

reviewed_items.label: JWT audienceのissuer受理
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: Issuer audience is accepted for private_key_jwt at Backchannel and for private_key_jwt/client_secret_jwt CIBA issuance and refresh; unrelated token flows retain their prior audience rules.

reviewed_items.label: JWT audienceのToken URL受理
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: Token endpoint URL is accepted as private_key_jwt audience at Backchannel, then the same client can complete and collect tokens.

reviewed_items.label: JWT audienceのBackchannel URL受理
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: Backchannel endpoint URL is accepted as private_key_jwt audience at Backchannel; resulting approved issuance succeeds.

reviewed_items.label: JWT audienceのissuer推奨
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: The recommendation to choose issuer audience is a client responsibility. OP acceptance tests establish support but do not prove external clients follow the recommendation.

reviewed_items.label: scope必須
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Missing scope fails before acceptance; malformed scope has a distinct invalid_scope response.

reviewed_items.label: openid scope
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: A scope set without openid is rejected for CIBA.

reviewed_items.label: 追加scope
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: An additional read scope allowed by both server and client survives acceptance and issuance.

reviewed_items.label: 通知トークン必須条件
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Ping requires a nonempty notification token before persistence. Push remains outside the implementation.

reviewed_items.label: 通知トークンの長さと構文
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Bearer syntax and1024-character ASCII boundary checked; CRLF, misplaced padding and non-ASCII rejected without pending records.

reviewed_items.label: 通知トークンentropy
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Required entropy is a client generation obligation. No syntax or length check can prove randomness. Minimum128/recommended160 bits are documented.

reviewed_items.label: acr_values受理
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Requested ACR preference order is retained in the frozen application dispatch snapshot; the gem does not choose an authentication method.

reviewed_items.label: 達成したacrの返却
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: ID Token carries the achieved ACR supplied at completion, even when different from requested preferences. Truthfulness and adequacy of the application authentication are not proven.

reviewed_items.label: login_hint_token
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Authenticated client is passed to the required application resolver; identity eligibility and raw-value exclusion are checked. Token-format validation belongs to the application.

reviewed_items.label: id_token_hint
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Verified ID Token identity creates a new pending request; approval is not inherited.

reviewed_items.label: 暗号化id_token_hintの復号
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Decrypting an encrypted ID Token before submitting its signed inner token is a Client duty. A real nested JWE is rejected by the gem; the decrypted signed hint is accepted. This matches measured node behavior, not missing OP decryption support.

reviewed_items.label: login_hint
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: A non-email customer reference resolves through an application callback in authenticated-client context. No built-in email interpretation is required.

reviewed_items.label: binding_messageの受理と引継ぎ
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Binding message is preserved for the application dispatch snapshot. Display on AD/CD, safe rendering and end-user confirmation remain application/client duties, not proven by the Ruby snapshot test.

reviewed_items.label: binding_messageの関連付け
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: The client must choose a meaningful correlation message. OP storage and dispatch cannot prove the correlation seen by the end-user.

reviewed_items.label: binding_messageの表示適性
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: The default node-aligned policy accepts 1–20 characters from its limited ASCII set and rejects whitespace, control and other characters. Applications may replace this display policy and own the resulting UI safety.

reviewed_items.label: user_code
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: Mandatory application verifier receives resolved account/client/code before insertion or dispatch; rejection has no pending request. Production verifier correctness remains application-owned.

reviewed_items.label: requested_expiry構文
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Unsigned requested_expiry accepts positive decimal syntax and rejects zero, negatives, fractions and nonnumeric strings. Signed JSON-number handling is audited separately.

reviewed_items.label: requested_expiryの採用
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Requested lifetime is used up to the configured maximum; the default and cap are directly asserted. Callback elapsed-time limits remain in CIBA-080.

reviewed_items.label: hintはちょうど一つ
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Exactly one recognized hint name is required; absent, empty and mixed hint inputs fail before resolver dispatch. The opt-in token resolver tests validate this with optional hints enabled.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求のJWT形式
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Signed inner parameters determine new pending work; normal request validation still applies.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求の非対称署名
reviewed_items.scope: configured RS/PS/ES algorithms and Ed25519/EdDSA with Ed25519 curve; signed CIBA requests only
reviewed_items.finding: All eleven configured algorithm names have reference/gem acceptance and wrong-key rejection evidence. Edwards Node/jose fixed vectors pass inline and actual HTTP remote JWKS on three DBs, reject payload tampering, and issue verified ID Tokens from the installed artifact with opaque/JWT access tokens. No global JWT/client-auth or Ed448 capability is implied.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求のaud
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: OP issuer audience membership is checked; incorrect/missing audience rejected. Array audience path is code-reviewed but not directly covered by this test.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求のiss
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Request issuer must match the independently authenticated client.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求のexp
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Required finite numeric exp, including fractional NumericDate, accepted only while unexpired under configured tolerance. Missing/string/boolean/array/expired values rejected before persistence.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求のiat
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Required finite numeric iat, including fractional and future values, matches measured reference acceptance. No independent future-iat restriction; valid exp/nbf and explicit customer approval still required.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求のnbf
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Required finite numeric nbf, including fractional NumericDate, checked against current time and configured tolerance. Future and malformed values rejected before persistence.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求のjti
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Like the reference, signed authentication requests require a present string jti, including empty strings; null/non-string values reject. Repeated identical requests produce distinct auth_req_id values with new pending approval, including after prior issuance. Identifier uniqueness remains a client obligation. This is separate from client authentication assertions, whose nonempty-jti and atomic replay checks are unchanged.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求のrequested_expiry型
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Integer and numeric-string requested_expiry are accepted through the ordinary expiry validator.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求の内外混在禁止
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Client must place authentication request parameters inside the JWT. OP ignores nonconforming outer protocol values rather than merging them; separate client authentication remains outside. Do not classify tolerated client input as evidence of client compliance.

reviewed_items.label: 暗号化要求非対応
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Five-part encrypted request shape is rejected; only three-part signed JWT requests enter verification.

reviewed_items.label: user_codeはOPパスワードと別
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: Documentation now explicitly requires a separate code from the OP login password. No application password/code policy is implemented or audited.

reviewed_items.label: user_codeの例外ポリシー
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: Callback can explicitly allow omission for a client/user. Tests cover false/omitted client metadata; arbitrary per-user policy correctness is not established.

reviewed_items.label: user_codeの都度入力
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: Client-side collection/non-storage is outside this OP gem. Gem-side removal from snapshots is separately tested and does not prove this client requirement.

reviewed_items.label: user_code変更手段
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: Application-owned code enrollment/change lifecycle is documented. No production change UI is supplied or tested.

reviewed_items.label: 登録方式による認証検証
reviewed_items.scope: Configured Basic/post, private_key_jwt/client_secret_jwt (fourteen algorithms), PKI/self-signed TLS; deployment trust and arbitrary extension combinations excluded
reviewed_items.finding: Configured methods have direct endpoint authentication/negative evidence. Fourteen RS/PS/ES/HS/Edwards algorithms have reference HTTP and gem verification evidence; Edwards adds DCR, remote HTTP rotation/failure, installed HTTPS retrieval with untrusted-TLS rejection, replay protection and ordinary-flow coexistence. A CIBA Edwards-only configuration preserves unrelated RSA client authentication and upstream metadata. See client-auth-edwards-scope-matrix.txt and client-auth-edwards-https-installed.txt. This is bounded protocol evidence, not deployment certification.

reviewed_items.label: 公開鍵認証の推奨
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: Prefer public-key client authentication when provisioning clients. The gem supports asymmetric methods but intentionally does not prohibit shared-secret authentication across the OP; deployment selection is not proven by feature support.

reviewed_items.label: 署名要求検証
reviewed_items.scope: signed authentication requests enabled; configured asymmetric algorithms
reviewed_items.finding: Configured eleven asymmetric algorithms have valid/wrong-key evidence (RS/PS/ES plus Ed25519/EdDSA). Required claims, NumericDate, jti type, issuer/audience, key selection/use/alg/key_ops, duplicate JSON, nested requests and encrypted shape have direct rejection tests. Edwards includes independent Node/jose vectors and remote keys. Current three-DB regressions pass; custom JOSE profiles and production key custody are not claimed.

reviewed_items.label: 認証要求パラメータ検証
reviewed_items.scope: Supported authentication parameter parser and callback boundaries, enumerated in docs/research/request-parameter-inventory.md; policy equivalence and deployment callback correctness are separate.
reviewed_items.finding: The supported parameter inventory is reconciled against the request route, common parser, feature validators and current full-suite tests. It covers transport/duplicates, scope, all enabled hints, binding/expiry/ACR, signed requests, user codes, ping notification tokens, nonce, claims/resources/RAR, max_age, request_context and ignored inputs. Application semantics and the explicit user-code/hint/cache policy differences remain separately tracked; this row does not assert those policies are identical or accepted.

reviewed_items.label: 複数hintのエラー
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Multiple hint names return invalid_request before resolving or saving the request, including opt-in login_hint_token combinations.

reviewed_items.label: hintとユーザーの検証
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Resolved accounts must remain eligible; a disabled account is rejected and a different completion account cannot approve the request. Arbitrary resolver correctness is application-owned.

reviewed_items.label: hintポリシーの伝達
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Accepted hint formats, issuer trust and age policy must be communicated by each deployment. Documentation describes the integration responsibility; no production client agreement is tested.

reviewed_items.label: 不正または不明hintのエラー
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Malformed hints return invalid_request; well-shaped unresolved hints return unknown_user_id before persistence.

reviewed_items.label: 必須パラメータ検証
reviewed_items.scope: Mandatory presence and exclusive hint selection for enabled poll/ping, signed requests and application-required user code; optional-value validation remains CIBA-067.
reviewed_items.finding: The supported mandatory parameter inventory is reconciled in docs/research/required-parameter-inventory.md. Direct tests cover scope, exclusive hints, registered request JWT, its six required claims, ping notification token and application-required user code. Actual signed omissions and missing/empty combined fields cannot be supplied by valid unsigned outer values; rejection occurs without persistence or device dispatch. Client authentication remains independently required. This verifies required presence/selection, not every optional value or application policy.

reviewed_items.label: 未知パラメータの無視
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Unknown parameters are ignored, including names resembling internal account, status and expiry fields. They neither override persisted state nor appear in the application snapshot.

reviewed_items.label: 開始エラーの形式
reviewed_items.scope: baseline request parameters and enabled hint-token boundary; UI and deployment policy remain external
reviewed_items.finding: Validation failures produce JSON protocol errors with the expected HTTP status and no token/request identifiers. Internal exceptions return server_error without private text.

reviewed_items.label: 受付成功HTTP 200
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: Validated baseline requests return HTTP 200; invalid hints, scopes and unsupported parameters do not receive successful acknowledgement.

reviewed_items.label: auth_req_id必須と一意性
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: Each accepted request receives a fresh base64url identifier. Its SHA256 digest has a database unique constraint; two observed identifiers differ. Forced RNG collision recovery is not tested.

reviewed_items.label: auth_req_id entropy
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: Source review confirms SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32), supplying 256 random input bits. Tests check encoding and distinct samples, not statistical entropy or the platform RNG implementation.

reviewed_items.label: auth_req_id文字集合
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: The 43-character unpadded base64url output uses only the permitted character set; direct response assertions cover the encoding.

reviewed_items.label: auth_req_idのopaque扱い
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: Opaque handling is a Client obligation. The OP generation test cannot prove how external clients interpret or store identifiers.

reviewed_items.label: expires_in
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: Positive integer lifetime, configured maximum and exact expiry are tested. The gem records its timestamp after client/hint validation; elapsed time before that timestamp is not accounted for as request-receipt time. Therefore the catalog requirement is only partially established. Deterministic callback-delay tests now establish identical timing in node 9.12.2 and the gem, including acknowledgement after expiry when dispatch exceeds lifetime; this is a shared limitation, not an unmeasured parity gap.

reviewed_items.label: interval
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: Returned interval is an integer: 1, 5 and the configured 32-bit maximum are accepted. Zero, negative, fractional, string and overflow configuration values are rejected. The reference OP omits this optional field; the gem explicitly advertises its polling policy.

reviewed_items.label: interval既定値
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: The five-second fallback when interval is omitted is a Client obligation; the gem normally returns an explicit interval.

reviewed_items.label: 未知応答パラメータ
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: Ignoring unknown acknowledgement fields is a Client obligation, not evidence about OP request-parameter parsing.

reviewed_items.label: 受付応答の必須項目確認
reviewed_items.scope: acknowledgement generation and baseline poll; client obligations separately classified
reviewed_items.finding: Client validation of required HTTP200 acknowledgement fields is outside this OP gem; valid gem responses do not prove client validation.

reviewed_items.label: auth_req_id保持
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: External clients must retain auth_req_id. OP storage is not evidence of client persistence.

reviewed_items.label: クライアント期限管理
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Callback cleanup and expiry tracking belong to the client; no production client cleanup is tested.

reviewed_items.label: 認証チャネルとacrの選択
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: The dispatch snapshot exposes requested ACR preferences and the resolved account. Channel selection and actual authentication assurance remain application-owned.

reviewed_items.label: 認証後の承認取得
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: The gem prevents issuance before explicit approval and checks the completion account. Authenticating the human and obtaining informed consent are application responsibilities, not established by an internal API call.

reviewed_items.label: 登録モード以外へ配送しない
reviewed_items.scope: Registered poll/ping mode and current endpoint at dispatch; no cancellation or distributed cache coherence guarantee
reviewed_items.finding: Aligned with measured provider9.12.2 HTTP management overlap: retry uses current registered endpoint with saved notification credential, switching to poll rejects retry, and in-flight sends retain their selected destination. Gem barrier tests use real management PUT and passed on SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL; token collection succeeds once. HTTPS metadata and existing outbound transport validation remain active.

reviewed_items.label: Token Endpoint認証
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA protocol transport and registered authentication; deployment and arbitrary method combinations remain separate
reviewed_items.finding: Token collection without client authentication is rejected without issuing a grant; registered assertion and post authentication succeed. CIBA authentication rejects replayed assertions and inappropriate explicit client identity.

reviewed_items.label: クライアントpoll間隔
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: The client must obey the minimum polling interval. Server slow_down enforcement does not prove client compliance.

reviewed_items.label: long polling
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Neither the selected node grant handler nor the gem implements a wait-for-result long-poll loop; pending requests return an error. The optional long-poll capability is not claimed.

reviewed_items.label: OP応答時間
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Unverified deployment obligation, not a passed timing guarantee. The gem has no hard30-second poll deadline across queues, DB waits and arbitrary hooks. The original catalog already assigns gem+deployment responsibility. docs/operations.md specifies end-to-end timeout budgeting, contention measurement and ambiguous post-commit timeout handling; an integrating service must supply production evidence.

reviewed_items.label: 重複poll禁止
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Clients must not overlap requests for one auth_req_id. Defensive concurrent redemption tests do not prove external client behavior.

reviewed_items.label: 503とRetry-After
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Injected DB lock timeout at acceptance and issuance yields 503 temporarily_unavailable with Retry-After and rolls back pending/grant mutation. This does not establish all production overload behavior.

reviewed_items.label: Retry-After遵守
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Respecting Retry-After is a client duty. Emitting the header does not establish client retries.

reviewed_items.label: pingクライアントのpoll許容
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Ping requests can be polled while pending and after approval; no successful notification receipt is needed to collect a saved result.

reviewed_items.label: Token POST form
reviewed_items.scope: baseline poll token exchange on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL; optional combinations audited separately
reviewed_items.finding: A form-encoded POST with non-rewindable Rack input successfully redeems an approved request. This is positive transport evidence, not an exhaustive charset or malformed-media matrix.

reviewed_items.label: Token grant_type必須
reviewed_items.scope: baseline poll token exchange on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL; optional combinations audited separately
reviewed_items.finding: Missing grant_type fails with invalid_request; successful requests use the exact CIBA grant value. Other OAuth grants retain their upstream dispatch.

reviewed_items.label: Token auth_req_id必須
reviewed_items.scope: baseline poll token exchange on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL; optional combinations audited separately
reviewed_items.finding: Missing and empty auth_req_id fail with invalid_request; an unissued identifier fails with invalid_grant without token persistence.

reviewed_items.label: auth_req_idのクライアント束縛
reviewed_items.scope: baseline poll token exchange on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL; optional combinations audited separately
reviewed_items.finding: The request lookup binds its digest to the authenticated client. A different authenticated client cannot redeem it or alter the request; wrong account completion and exact expiry also reject issuance.

reviewed_items.label: 成功Token応答
reviewed_items.scope: baseline poll token exchange on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL; optional combinations audited separately
reviewed_items.finding: Approved baseline issuance returns access_token, signed issuer/audience-verified ID Token, bearer token type, positive integer lifetime and no-store/no-cache headers. This does not certify every optional claims/resource/sender-binding combination.

reviewed_items.label: 成功後の一回限り消費
reviewed_items.scope: baseline poll token exchange on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL; optional combinations audited separately
reviewed_items.finding: Sequential redemption is rejected after success. Ten two-connection races per DB each yield exactly one successful signed response and one invalid_grant, with one grant per request. Arbitrary hooks and distributed adapters are outside this test.

reviewed_items.label: 認証承認前のToken禁止
reviewed_items.scope: baseline poll token exchange on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL; optional combinations audited separately
reviewed_items.finding: Pending, throttled-pending and denied requests return errors without access_token, id_token or refresh_token and create no OAuth grant. Customer authentication itself is supplied through the application completion boundary.

reviewed_items.label: ping HTTP POST
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Application completion sends POST for approval and denial after commit. Expiry does not require a callback. Transaction rollback sends none.

reviewed_items.label: ping bearer認証
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Outgoing Authorization Bearer contains the request notification token; signed requests cannot be overridden by an outer value.

reviewed_items.label: ping payload
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Only auth_req_id is sent as JSON; no tokens or consent payload accompany a ping.

reviewed_items.label: pingクライアント検証
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Receiver validation of bearer/auth_req_id association and invalid-bearer401 is outside this OP. Existing sender tests do not establish a production receiver implementation.

reviewed_items.label: ping応答処理
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Ping accepts200/204 based on headers and closes without reading or draining the body. A real peer declaring10MB and withholding it observes immediate closure; installed/reference TLS fixtures accept140,000 ignored bytes. JWKS/sector body limits, TLS verification, address and redirect policies remain in force.

reviewed_items.label: pingリダイレクト禁止
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Shared HTTP transport issues one request with no redirect handling. Installed TLS smoke rejects302 and sends only on explicit retry; this is not merely a mock assertion.

reviewed_items.label: ping後の取得
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: The client retrieves tokens after validating a notification. OP tests demonstrate retrieval works, not that every client performs the required validation.

reviewed_items.label: 通知Endpoint TLS
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Ping endpoints require HTTPS; installed smoke uses verified TLS and rejects an untrusted receiver before credentials arrive. Arbitrary deployments remain application-owned.

reviewed_items.label: 通知Endpoint bearer認証
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Ping sends the saved client_notification_token as Bearer; receiver verification remains a separate client duty.

reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Required-parameter and unknown-request errors are JSON with cache suppression and no error_uri. Early authentication halts now receive no-store/no-cache from the CIBA HTTP boundary.

reviewed_items.label: authorization_pending
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Pending requests return authorization_pending and persist polling timestamps without issuing tokens.

reviewed_items.label: slow_down
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Repeated early pending polls return slow_down and add five seconds to the saved interval, including concurrent calls. The reference delegates polling control to application policy; identical default throttling behavior is not claimed.

reviewed_items.label: expired_token
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: An approved request at its exact expiry returns expired_token without issuing a grant.

reviewed_items.label: access_denied
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Application denial returns access_denied on poll. This is token retrieval after denial, distinct from pre-interaction HTTP403 policy rejection.

reviewed_items.label: invalid_grant
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Unknown request identifiers and identifiers owned by another authenticated client return invalid_grant without issuing tokens or mutating the foreign request.

reviewed_items.label: 繰返し過剰pollの拒否
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Optional terminal invalid_request after repeated fast polling is not implemented by either baseline. Gem continues slow_down with interval increases; node pending handler has no equivalent built-in throttling.

reviewed_items.label: invalid_request後の停止
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Stopping polls after invalid_request is an external client duty, not an OP feature.

reviewed_items.label: 開始エラーJSON
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Six rejection/failure paths return JSON with ASCII error codes, no tokens or request identifiers, and cache suppression. Unexpected exceptions do not expose their messages.

reviewed_items.label: error_description文字集合
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Allowed ASCII error descriptions survive; quotes, backslashes, newlines and non-ASCII custom descriptions are omitted.

reviewed_items.label: error_uri文字集合
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: The tested upstream responses do not emit error_uri. No custom URI injection mechanism or URI-syntax sanitizer is established; the conditional field is absent rather than positively validated.

reviewed_items.label: 400 invalid_request
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Missing or malformed parameters, duplicate form fields and conflicting hints return HTTP400 invalid_request. Specific optional hint combinations have separate evidence.

reviewed_items.label: 400 invalid_scope
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Missing scope returns invalid_request; present malformed or disallowed scopes return HTTP400 invalid_scope.

reviewed_items.label: 400 expired_login_hint_token
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Application expiry errors become HTTP400 expired_login_hint_token; unexpected resolver errors become HTTP500 without pending records or dispatch. The gem does not infer arbitrary token expiry.

reviewed_items.label: 400 unknown_user_id
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: A validly shaped but unresolved login_hint returns HTTP400 unknown_user_id before request persistence.

reviewed_items.label: 400 unauthorized_client
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: Clients lacking CIBA eligibility return HTTP400 unauthorized_client without creating requests; registered mode and grant changes are checked.

reviewed_items.label: 400 missing_user_code
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: Application-declared missing code yields the protocol error before dispatch.

reviewed_items.label: 400 invalid_user_code
reviewed_items.scope: user-code feature enabled unless otherwise stated
reviewed_items.finding: False/nil validation yields invalid_user_code; malformed input instead fails request validation.

reviewed_items.label: 400 invalid_binding_message
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: An oversized binding message returns HTTP400 invalid_binding_message before request persistence. Application-specific acceptable message content is separately configurable.

reviewed_items.label: 401 invalid_client
reviewed_items.scope: CIBA error envelopes and baseline poll; authentication transports additionally exercised by the three-DB subset
reviewed_items.finding: At both CIBA endpoints, absent client identity returns HTTP400 invalid_request without a challenge; wrong Basic credentials return HTTP401 invalid_client with a Basic challenge. Matches measured reference boundary. Assertion-based identification without client_id remains supported; JWT/mTLS and non-CIBA regression subset passes on three DBs. Does not claim identical precedence for all malformed-input combinations.

reviewed_items.label: 403 access_denied
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: An explicit application rejection can send HTTP403 access_denied before persistence or device dispatch. The reference supports explicit OIDCProviderError(403), while its default AccessDenied is 400; gem ProtocolError also defaults to 400. Application policy must choose the appropriate status.

reviewed_items.label: login_hint_token署名
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Issuer-signature policy is delegated to the token-format resolver. Existing fixtures use opaque references and do not prove signature validation for a production login_hint_token format.

reviewed_items.label: 通知URLの管理権限
reviewed_items.scope: ping enabled; statements shared with push are assessed for ping only
reviewed_items.finding: Application should establish notification endpoint administrative ownership. HTTPS/IP filtering and immutable destination snapshots are not proof of client ownership; no universal ownership protocol is supplied.

reviewed_items.label: 期限切れid_token_hint許容
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Expired ID hints are accepted, with optional maximum age from iat. Default unlimited age while keys remain trusted matches the measured reference; deployment-specific reasonable retention has not been established.

reviewed_items.label: id_token_hintのissuerとaudience
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Trusted OP issuer and authenticated-client audience membership are verified before subject resolution; wrong issuer/audience are rejected.

reviewed_items.label: id_token_hint署名
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Configured asymmetric/Edwards signatures use trusted current or retained OP keys; HMAC issuance and hint verification use the client secret, with no OP-key fallback. Actual issuance/reuse and wrong-key rejection have direct tests. HMAC Basic/POST and hashed/plaintext storage pass three-DB and independent jose checks; installed-gem issuance/refresh/hints and backend secret replacement pass, as do Ruby 3.3/3.4 full suites. DCR generates sufficiently long HS256/384/512 secrets. This verifies the signature boundary, not all deployment rotation policies. Encrypted hints are rejected by both implementations; optional signature-free pairwise acceptance is not required by this catalog guidance.

reviewed_items.label: push Endpoint保護
reviewed_items.scope: push mode, unsupported by pinned node 9.12.2 and the gem; poll/ping remain in scope
reviewed_items.finding: Conditional push behavior is not implemented or advertised. Pinned node 9.12.2 rejects push provider configuration; the gem rejects push registration and request eligibility. This records non-applicability to the shared enabled modes, not a passing push implementation.

reviewed_items.label: 業務コンテキストの追加
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: Opt-in request_context is validated in authenticated client context, stored and dispatched; signed input controls it, poll cannot replace it, and it is excluded from identity claims and observation events. Business meaning remains application-specific.

reviewed_items.label: プライバシー配慮識別子
reviewed_items.scope: application/client boundaries and optional polling policies; no production deployment certification
reviewed_items.finding: App-defined opaque login_hint references and token resolvers support alternatives to global identifiers. Actual unlinkability, identifier lifetime and privacy policy are not guaranteed by accepting an arbitrary string.

reviewed_items.label: pairwise ID Token hint
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: Actual signed pairwise ID Token maps through an application resolver to a canonical account and creates a request without saved consent. Arbitrary resolver correctness is not proven.

reviewed_items.label: 一回限り識別子hint token
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: The optional AD-to-CD one-use reference protocol is not implemented. A resolver hook can integrate it; its existence does not prove atomic single-use handling or privacy properties.

reviewed_items.label: Discovery Service hint token
reviewed_items.scope: optional hint mechanisms enabled where applicable
reviewed_items.finding: The optional discovery-service encrypted login_hint_token format is not implemented. Decryption and issuer/audience policy belong to an application resolver; no complete deployment has been tested.
